title: Lecturer in Urban Planning and Design, Curator of the Loeb Fellowship
affiliation: Department of Architecture, Department of Urban Planning and Design
bio: James Stockard, an expert in affordable housing and community development, retired in 2014 from the role of curator of the Loeb Fellowship, which he held for 17 years.
